venues.alt: CIRQ Roppongi La Foresta hall, B1

venues.name: Bellesalle Roppongi (ベルサール六本木)
venues.addr: Roppongi, Minato-ku, Tokyo 106-0032 (bellesalle official page; building detail on request)
venues.cap: 1F Hall A 84 / Hall B 90 / combined whole-floor 1F Hall up to ~300 (est); plus B1 hall
venues.linkText: Bellesalle Roppongi
venues.note: Sister Sumitomo Bellesalle hall 2 min from Roppongi Sta exit 2. Smaller sister of the Grand Conference Center, useful for mid-size tech meetups / 50–200 people. Same EN email on the 'For overseas corporations' panel; do not confuse with the Grand CC address.
venues.alt: Bellesalle Roppongi 1F and B1 hall

venues.name: AZABUballoon (麻布バルーン)
venues.addr: Azabu-Juban vicinity, Minato-ku, Tokyo (詳細な住所・内見は問合せフォームから)
venues.cap: 100standing / 80 seated; 202.51 m2 (61.25 tsubo)
venues.linkText: AZABUballoon
venues.note: Independent live/event space 4 min from Azabu-Juban, 8 min from Akabanebashi — short hop from Roppongi. Pro audio/lighting, 6.6 m stage, onsite kitchen and bar; ok on the smaller end for a 50–100-person casual coffee/hack day. JP-primary site — partner with a JP speaker to book.
venues.alt: AZABUballoon event space, stage + counter bar
